title: MiniQMT execution gates are duplicated across layers without a canonical preflight contract
description:
Expected: MiniQMT strategy-package execution should have one canonical readiness/preflight contract that normalizes trade date, data readiness, StrategyPackage runtime assets, target portfolio, market-state/tradability, board-lot, cash, lot availability, broker can_sell, idempotency, and SIM/LIVE mode. Later layers may assert the canonical decision and broker authority, but must not reimplement different simplified business rules.
Actual: The current flow spreads checks across preopen runner/data readiness, SelectionPackageHealthService, package_binding, SelectionOrderBuilder, QmtManagedOrderService preview/submit, raw QMT routes, broker checks, sync_service attribution, and reconciliation. BUG-048 proves this architecture can generate legal STAR-market quantities in the builder and then reject them with an inconsistent simplified 100-share rule in order_service. Operators also observed excessive repeated gates around StrategyPackage assets and daily simulation readiness.
reproduce_command: rg -n "preflight|readiness|require_runnable|board_lot|round_to_board_lot|quantity % 100|strategy package|can_sell|available_quantity|daily_basic|stk_limit|suspend_d" backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger backend/services/selection_center backend/services/strategy_package backend/routers/qmt_strategy_ledger.py backend/routers/qmt.py backend/execution_algos/board_lot.py docs/architecture/miniqmt_multi_strategy_execution_implementation_plan_20260518.md -S
required_verification: Design record: canonical miniQMT readiness/preflight contract lists every gate owner, input, output, blocking semantics, and UI/API error code.
Regression test: SelectionOrderBuilder and QmtManagedOrderService accept/reject identical BUY/SELL board-lot quantities, including STAR-market 688/689 cases.
Regression test: daily_basic is not used as a pre-open miniQMT execution gate; pre-open gates use datasets actually available before open such as stk_limit/suspend_d where required.
Regression test: package/data/tradability/lot/cash/broker gates return a single actionable reason instead of conflicting layer errors.
Guardrail or test prevents adding a second hard-coded board-lot/tradability implementation outside the canonical rule source.
closure_requirements: Necessary safety gates remain, but duplicate inconsistent business-rule implementations are removed or downgraded to invariant assertions.
Board-lot, tradability, package health, data readiness, cash, lot availability, and SIM/LIVE checks have clear canonical ownership.
The miniQMT execution flow is simpler to reason about and documented for future POC/live operation.
BUG-048 class split-brain validation cannot recur under the new contract.

events.note: This is a design/refactor issue, not a request to remove safety checks. The goal is to keep necessary gates but remove duplicate inconsistent implementations.
Business impact: P1 because duplicated gates increase complexity and bug risk in trading code; BUG-048 is the concrete failure example.
Expected design output: a miniQMT canonical readiness/preflight contract document or module with each gate's owner, input, output, blocking semantics, and test oracle.

Expected implementation output: board-lot/tradability/data/package checks have one source of truth; downstream layers consume canonical decisions or assert invariants instead of recalculating simplified rules.

Required verification: regression proving builder and order_service accept/reject the same BUY/SELL quantities; daily_basic is not a pre-open miniQMT execution gate; gate failures expose a single actionable reason in UI/API.
Non-goal: do not weaken broker/miniQMT final validation, SIM/LIVE guard, strategy ledger attribution, or no-silent-fallback asset checks.
